note: Names and notes only. No component code is stored here; items are installed from their own registries into the user's project.

@aceternity.redistribution: not allowed; the published terms cover Pro and forbid redistributing source or bundling it into templates. Check the terms before commercial use.

kinds.ambient: Animated or decorative page background. At most one per page.
kinds.loop: Content that moves on its own, such as a marquee.
kinds.accent: Highlight on a single control or card.
kinds.interaction: Responds to pointer or hover only.
kinds.content: Animates a value the user reads.

candidates.fit: Static SVG grid; the calmest option and no motion to gate.
issues: Uses palette classes (gray-*) for strokes; map them to border or muted-foreground.

candidates.fit: Dot field with an optional glow; reads well behind dense copy.
issues: Imports motion/react without declaring motion as a dependency; install motion first.
